description: This file defines the `ExpiresParsingMiddleware` class, which is used within the AWS SDK for PHP to handle the parsing of the 'expires' header in S3 responses. The middleware logs a warning if the 'expires' header fails to be parsed correctly.

classes.name: ExpiresParsingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class to handle and log warnings related to parsing of the 'expires' header in AWS S3 responses.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that initializes the middleware with a given handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that takes a callable next handler to be invoked in the middleware chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, processes the command and request, and logs a warning if the 'expires' header fails to parse.
